title: Anita Roddick, a Refused Loan and a Green Shop in Brighton
conflicts: Loan given as GBP 4,000 by British sources and as USD 6,500 by Entrepreneur (2008), a conversion; story uses GBP 4,000. Second-shop investor is a friend (Entrepreneur 1996) or a local garage owner (Irish Times); story uses garage owner, unnamed. Funeral parlours across the road (Post Magazine) or on both sides (NZ Herald); story says nearby. Growth: about 700 shops 15 years on (Brighton & Hove Museums) used.
notes: First-day takings of GBP 130 rest on Entrepreneur (1996) alone. Repeat screen flags the Big Issue edition for the surname Roddick; that is Gordon Roddick and a different company, so the founder field was left unchanged.
